verdict.rationale: Granola Chat lets you ask natural-language questions about your meetings and get answers from your notes or transcripts, including spotting patterns across customer calls. Granola MCP also lets external AI tools search past meetings for specific topics. This covers the core of cross-history Q&A. However, the evidence never shows chat answers citing their source meetings or transcript passages; the magnifying-glass sourcing applies only to AI-enhanced notes, not to chat answers. Missing for 10: documented source citations in chat answers, explicit confirmation that chat spans the entire meeting history, independent or hands-on corroboration.
